items.q: Intracellular kidney bean diplococci inside neutrophils in urethral pus indicate what?
o: Neisseria gonorrhoeae needing ceftriaxone plus doxycycline
items.exp: Oxidase positive diplococci in polymorphs are diagnostic; NAAT confirms with Thayer-Martin culture for resistance while doxycycline covers chlamydial coinfection. Chlamydia never shows on Gram stain.
r: Incorrect. Chlamydia is invisible on Gram.

items.q: Right upper quadrant pain with violin string adhesions in PID is which syndrome and treated how?
o: Fitz-Hugh-Curtis perihepatitis with prolonged antigonococcal plus antichlamydial therapy
items.exp: Gonococci or chlamydia ascend to Glisson capsule sticking liver to wall; antibiotics with admission criteria resolve while surgery finds a normal gallbladder. LFTs stay near normal.
items.kp: PID plus liver edge pain: Fitz-Hugh-Curtis.

items.q: Purulent neonatal conjunctivitis on day 3 is most likely gonococcal; how does chlamydial timing differ?
o: Chlamydial inclusion conjunctivitis appears day 5 to 14
items.exp: Gonococci incubate 2 to 5 days threatening perforation rapidly while chlamydia takes 5 to 14 days milder; erythromycin ointment prevents both with systemic therapy when established. Chemical irritation strikes day 1.

items.q: Migratory arthralgia with tenosynovitis and sparse pustules in a young adult suggests what?
items.exp: Bacteraemic gonococci seed tendon sheaths with few skin lesions; blood and mucosal NAAT confirm while joint fluid stays often sterile. Septic arthritis instead destroys one joint purulently.
items.kp: Tendons plus pustules that wander: DGI.

items.q: Neck stiffness with non blanching purpuric rash and shock in a teenager is managed first how?
o: Immediate ceftriaxone for meningococcaemia with resuscitation
items.exp: Every hour of delay raises mortality as endotoxin drives DIC; benzylpenicillin suits only proven sensitive strains while dexamethasone debates follow. Platelets with coagulation guide blood products.
r: Incorrect. No vesicles or temporal signs.
items.kp: Purpura plus stiff neck: needle and ceftriaxone now.

items.q: Bilateral adrenal haemorrhage with fulminant meningococcaemia is which syndrome?
o: Waterhouse-Friderichsen with steroids for adrenal failure
items.exp: DIC infarcts adrenals during overwhelming sepsis collapsing pressure; stress dose hydrocortisone bridges while antibiotics with intensive care decide survival. Chronic Addison pigmentations differ.
r: Incorrect. This is hours, not months.

items.q: Recurrent meningococcal disease in a young adult should prompt evaluation of what?
o: Terminal complement C5 to C9 deficiency with vaccination
items.exp: Membrane attack failure lets neisseriae survive opsonisation; CH50/AH50 with component assays confirm while tetravalent plus MenB vaccines and education protect. Asplenia risks pneumococcus more.

items.q: Close household contacts of meningococcal meningitis need what?
o: Chemoprophylaxis with rifampicin, ciprofloxacin or ceftriaxone
items.exp: Carriage seeds secondary cases within days; prophylaxis eradicates colonisation while vaccines take weeks to protect. The index case also needs carriage clearance post therapy.

items.q: Why is there no gonococcal vaccine while meningococcal ACWY vaccine works?
o: Gonococcal pili and Opa antigens vary; meningococcal capsules are stable targets
items.exp: Phase and antigenic variation outruns immunity while conserved capsular polysaccharides conjugate into memory; MenB needed protein approach for sialic mimicry. Behavioural prevention fills the gap.
r: Correct. Variable pili versus stable capsule.

items.q: Thayer-Martin agar grows gonococci selectively by which principle?
o: Antibiotics suppressing normal flora with chocolate base for fastidious diplococci
items.exp: Vancomycin, colistin and nystatin hold commensals while heated blood factors feed gonococci; NAAT now leads diagnosis with culture reserved for resistance. Plain chocolate overgrows.
